news.title: Week in review: ‘Karen’ comment doesn’t show discrimination, judge says
news.summary: We’re rounding up last week’s stories and news, including cost of living increases and the rising ghosting problem.

news.title: DOL finalizes sweeping pharmacy benefit manager disclosure rule
news.summary: Starting in 2027, the controversial drug middlemen will have to share a broad swath of fee and compensation data with self-funded employer clients.

news.title: Workers are ‘habit hugging’ despite new training, survey finds
news.summary: The term describes employees who don’t consistently use new work methods they’ve been trained on, representing a learning and development challenge, TalentLMS said.

news.title: Companies are not saving money with AI, Gartner finds
news.summary: Although many organizations have invested significantly in artificial intelligence, workforce productivity gains have not kept up, a recent study found.

news.title: About 1 in 3 workers say they’re faking their skills
news.summary: Lying is becoming normalized across work settings, studies show.

news.title: Verizon, Franklin Electric announce new HR leaders in October
news.summary: Companies in high-speed networking, live entertainment and other industries also brought on new leaders.

news.title: Gap Inc. launches AI hiring tool in time for the holidays
news.summary: The retailer expects around 200,000 seasonal employment applications. Its new AI platform aims to reduce the administrative tasks associated with hiring.

news.title: How HR can help workers ask the right questions during open enrollment
news.summary: Workers may be afraid to ask about their choices due to fear of discrimination or anxiety, experts said.

news.title: PwC confirms learning records breached in attack on vendor site
news.summary: The professional services firm was the subject of a claim by a known ransomware actor.

news.title: AI at work: Employees, employers may not be on the same page
news.summary: A study from Dayforce highlights workers’ fears about how AI use might make their work life worse.
